pages.article_html:
Reduced To Blood And Howls

Level 28 · Adventuring · Thelaseen

Objectives

Slay Bloodhowler sentinels around Nathefel, then speak to Nathefel. - Bloodhowler Sentinels (0/18)

Description

Nathefel says, "Finally, an adventurer! I thought all you sellswords were down south combating the drake riders." "Could you please take out the Bloodhowler sentinels?" "You're welcome to slay the other Bloodhowlers, but it's really the sentinels that keep us from being able to reunite with our herd."

What they say

On offering it

Nathefel
Finally, an adventurer! I thought all you sellswords were down south combating the drake riders. Could you please take out the Bloodhowler sentinels? You're welcome to slay the other Bloodhowlers, but it's really the sentinels that keep us from being able to reunite with our herd.

Recorded by quest description.

Another account

A second source described this quest differently. Both are kept here; neither is a correction of the other.

findings.observation: Current objective explicitly requests slaying Bloodhowler sentinels around Nathefel, then speaking to Nathefel; tracker prints Bloodhowler Sentinels (0/18). Fandom-attributed alternate account prints Bloodhowler Sentinels Slain (18). Preserve tracker wording and progress context separately; the count is 18 in both accounts.

Offering dialogue distinguishes sentinels from other Bloodhowlers: the other Bloodhowlers may be slain but sentinels prevent reunion with the herd. Do not widen the objective to all Bloodhowlers or infer credit mechanics for other enemies.

Starts with and Hand in to both name Nathefel. Starts in and header name Thelaseen; location prints 78483, -75349, 1121 in Thelassen (-22, 24). Preserve spelling and coordinate contexts without treating the parenthesized pair as another world spawn or assigning coordinate axes.
Both Previous and Next link Retrieve Our Lost Kin. Series prints Unicorn. This contradictory navigation is retained without creating an enforced prerequisite cycle or deciding intended chain order.

Header prints Level 28 and Adventuring. These are page observations; historical minimum level, repeatability, experience, money and item rewards are not supplied in the cached article and remain unknown.

Source links an archived MMODB page at vgoemulator.net. The alternate objective is attributed to fandom within this archive page. Neither original was downloaded in this iteration; mirror attribution is not independent corroboration.
